findingsAndLimits.manualProcedure: Re=rho*v*D/eta; D=1/100m eta=1/1000Pa*s => Re=10*rho*v; rho1000 gives10000v. Newtonian liquid and diameter-based Reynolds definition. Density absent in prompt-only projection:1000kg/m³ conditional. Convert1cm to.01m; dimensions cancel.
